criteria.requirement: Loading that URL must use the supplied local XML and make no OSM API request.
criteria.action: Serve the repository locally, block external requests, and load the specified audit URL; wait for window.osmAudit and inspect the scene and report.
criteria.expected: The existing building meshes render, no OSM API request occurs, and the report identifies outer 100 with parts ordered 201 then 202. (Tolerance: Exact ids and ordering; no external OSM requests)

criteria.requirement: compute bounds with `new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(wall)` in world coordinates
criteria.action: Independently update world matrices and compute Box3 bounds for b100, b201, and b202, then compare them with the report and derived footprint/baseY/topY fields.
criteria.expected: Every reported bound and derived scalar matches the corresponding live wall mesh calculation. (Tolerance: 1e-6 per numeric component)

criteria.requirement: part 202 crosses the outer footprint and is taller than the outer wall
criteria.action: Read the initial report entries for parts 201 and 202 and independently evaluate the epsilon containment and height formulas.
criteria.expected: Part 201 has contained=true and heightViolation=false; part 202 has contained=false and heightViolation=true. (Tolerance: Exact booleans; formula epsilon 0.001)

criteria.requirement: add one `Box3Helper` for the outer wall and one per valid part
criteria.action: Inspect the live spatialAudit group, helper boxes, and helper material colors after initial loading.
criteria.expected: The group contains exactly three helpers: blue for outer 100, green for 201, and red for 202, with boxes equal to their audited wall bounds. (Tolerance: Exact count and colors; 1e-6 per box component)

criteria.requirement: Recomputing after a mesh transform or geometry replacement must use the new live bounds, not cached XML dimensions.
criteria.action: Translate b201 in world X beyond the outer footprint, call refresh, inspect its entry and helper, then restore the transform and refresh again.
criteria.expected: The moved part becomes uncontained with a red helper and updated bounds; restoring it restores contained=true, a green helper, and the original bounds without camera or building resets. (Tolerance: 1e-6 per restored bound; exact booleans and colors)

criteria.requirement: append a human-readable string containing its id to `issues`, omit an invalid part entry and its helper, and continue auditing other parts
criteria.action: Temporarily rename b201 so it cannot be found, call refresh, and inspect the report and helper group before restoring the name.
criteria.expected: Issues contains 201, part 201 and its helper are omitted, outer and part 202 remain audited, and no uncaught exception occurs. (Tolerance: Exact remaining part ids and helper count)

criteria.requirement: Without `audit`, do not create audit helpers or change existing behavior.
criteria.action: Load the same local fixture without the audit parameter and inspect the scene, controls, and global audit API.
criteria.expected: No spatialAudit group is present, normal meshes and OrbitControls remain available, and no audit report is generated. (Tolerance: Exact absence of audit group and report)

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the initial rendered 3D scene and its declared state. Inspect task-relevant depth and geometry across at least three views where appropriate, and inspect composition, materials, lighting, color, and legibility.
Exercise the central interaction and numeric or geometry contract through the visible UI. Verify meaningful scene/state feedback without inventing unrequested controls.
Repeat the boundary, invalid-input, recovery, and reset sequence while inspecting live scene state.
Inspect 1440x900 and 390x844 layouts, including lower controls and keyboard focus. Reload and inspect console/resource diagnostics.
